summary: Fix iOS conversation history pagination by sending only the cursor on timeline continuation requests

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, indexes, stored data or schema-version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, authority or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: iOS timeline continuations omit the explicit limit so the server retains the opaque cursor's bound page size instead of rejecting a mismatched limit with page-cursor-expired. Initial reads and expired-cursor restarts retain the existing 200-item request limit. No API schema, credentials, permissions or authority changes.

downtime.detail: No server restart, migration or service interruption required.

manual.detail: No operator action, configuration changes or device re-pairing required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or additional rollback restrictions.
